business_problem: Meliá needed a homogeneous, secure, and scalable global technology environment that could respond quickly to the needs of a growing hotel group while simplifying hotel management and supporting guest and employee experience.
solution_summary: Telefónica is extending its long-running managed-services partnership with Meliá by using artificial intelligence inside a global Service Desk operating model that supports more than 250 hotels in 40 countries. The implementation centers on the Service Desk model as the front door for technical assistance, incidents, and digital-solution support across nearly 9,000 devices in hotels and corporate headquarters. AI is applied to automate requests, assist monthly support conversations, and move the service toward more predictive and proactive incident handling. Around that core, Telefónica provides workplace management, field support, functional support, communications, cloud services, and advanced cybersecurity services to keep the environment consistent and secure. The broader architecture also includes connected hotels, 5G connectivity, and network slicing in selected properties to guarantee service levels for demanding connectivity scenarios such as live video streaming.

solution_components.name: Service Desk model
solution_components.role: Acts as the central managed support layer for technical assistance, incidents, digital solutions, workplace management, and communications across Meliá hotels and headquarters.

solution_components.name: artificial intelligence
solution_components.role: Automates requests, assists support conversations, and improves proactive and predictive incident resolution within the Service Desk.

solution_components.name: cloud services
solution_components.role: Supports the global digital services model that underpins Meliá's homogeneous and scalable technology environment.

solution_components.name: advanced cybersecurity services
solution_components.role: Protects Meliá's systems and data and helps ensure business continuity in the managed environment.

solution_components.name: 5G connectivity
solution_components.role: Provides hotel connectivity, including indoor NSA 5G and SA 5G coverage in at least one flagship property.

solution_components.name: network slicing technology
solution_components.role: Creates virtual 5G slices to guarantee service levels for connectivity use cases such as live video streaming during peak demand.

data_flow: Support requests and AI-assisted conversations from hotels and corporate headquarters enter Telefónica's Service Desk, where automation and AI help triage and resolve incidents. Cases are then handled through workplace, field, cloud, security, functional support, and communications services, with the resulting support delivered back into Meliá's day-to-day hotel operations across its global estate.
business_outcome: The program increases automation, enables more proactive support, speeds incident resolution, and reinforces a secure, consistent, globally integrated technology environment for Meliá's hotel operations.
